title: The mark, on the line
summary: The big lockup now sits above the legal row, on its hairline: the line buries its lower fifth, so nothing of the brand hangs below it, and © with Privacy | Terms and Audit request is the page's last edge. It keeps the round-5 picks: one quiet tone, about 70% of the content width, set right, one-fifth buried.

reference.site: Round 1 · A ('FIG. 11 · The mark, installed'), with one registration touch from C
reference.borrowed: From footer A (after Zellerfeld), the whole language the founder picked: the red-square caps label; four equal sitemap strips divided by full-height hairlines (mono index, wide 32px title, 17px items); the two doors lifted in --fg with drawn arrows; the Contact strip with audit@kelwin.co, the London readout and the colophon lines; an 88px hairline band with a Privacy | Terms pair and an outlined AUDIT REQUEST ↗; and the real lockup set margin to margin. From C, one touch only: + registration marks where the band's hairline meets the margins.
reference.kelwin: The founder's fixes, as they stand in round 9. (1) The lockup is one flat, quiet tone (rgba 251,250,246,.13, rendered from the founder's master via .km-logo), so the red piece is gone (round 2). (2) It is buried by a fifth: about 70% of the content width (918 × 190px at 1440), set right on the margin, in a box 80% of its height (152px) that ends exactly where the legal hairline begins, so the line is the cut (rounds 4–5 picked the width and the fifth; round 9 moved the cut from the footer's bottom edge to the legal hairline). Above the line you see the mark's bar and two squares with a sliver of the smallest one, and the wordmark cut just above its baseline. (3) Round 9: nothing of the brand hangs below the legal row. The order is sitemap → lockup → legal row, and the legal row is the page's last edge. The band's hairline carries + marks at x 64 / 1376, the same marks the hero puts at its frame corners, so the page's frame closes where it opened; the right + lands on the lockup's lower-right corner. Door names match the hero and nav exactly: the /contact door reads 'Talk to the Team' (it was 'Get in Touch'), and the second column reads 'The Firm' (the nav's word). The only red is the 8px label square, which is family punctuation. The band's AUDIT REQUEST ↗ is the kit's .ac-btn-o, the same 44px button as in the nav. History (round 2, superseded by rounds 4, 5 and 9): the lockup spanned cols 1–12 (1312 × 271.7px) in a container half its height, cut by the footer's bottom edge, with the legal row above the crop (DIRECTION-AC §5.3); the FIG. 11 caption went then.

motion: entrance, along the reading path (--ease-out unless stated): the label fades in (300ms). The strip hairlines draw downward (900ms, 80ms stagger), and each strip's index, title and items rise 12px in that order, 01 → 04 (600ms, 90ms stagger per strip). Then the end beat: the legal hairline draws left to right (1.1s from 450ms, as the last strip's items rise); its left + registers as the line starts (450ms) and its right + as the line arrives (1.1s). The © line fades in as the line passes it (500ms at 750ms), then the Privacy | Terms / Audit request controls as it reaches them (500ms at 1s). The end beat's times count from the moment half the legal row is on screen; when it already is as the section plays (the reader is at the bottom), that moment is the play, and the timings above hold as written.

orchestrated moment, and the last thing to move: the lockup makes a single slow rise out of the line. It starts fully behind the legal hairline (translateY 82% of its height) and begins only once the line is drawn under it; with --ease-inout it clears the line at ≈1.4s, as the controls settle, and lands in its crop, one-fifth buried, by ≈3.1s (2s from 1.1s, on the end beat's clock). It never moves again: no assembly, no red, no loop (mark policy §4).
ambient: nothing visible. The London readout updates its hours:minutes every 15s and never ticks seconds.

interaction: sitemap links lift from --fg-2 to --fg and grow an underline from the left (250ms). The door arrows nudge (↗ 2px up-right, → 3px right). Privacy and Terms invert to --fg on hover. The outlined AUDIT REQUEST ↗ border lifts to --fg and its arrow nudges.

on the live site: the footer plays once when 22% of it is visible (the Slot, IntersectionObserver, capped at 35% of the viewport for a tall footer; no pin), and the strips cascade at once. The end beat (the legal hairline and its + marks, © and the controls, the lockup's rise) waits for the reader: footer-behavior.ts (U.js in the mockup) sets data-end="wait" on the root and holds those five animations at their first frame until half the legal row is on screen, then clears it and they play in their order. Without it, on a 390 × 844 phone the footer played with the legal hairline ≈895px below the fold and the rise finished off-screen; now the line draws and the lockup rises as you arrive at the bottom, at every width. Fail-open: the flag is set only once the observer is watching, so if the behaviour fails nothing is held. Reduced motion (no .is-play / no km-motion; the behaviour runs with reduced:true) shows the final state at once, holds nothing, writes the London time once and starts no timer.
notes: Round 9 (the founder, verbatim): “And also, one more thing I feel I noticed that feels kind of off is that Kelwin logo at the end of the footer. Right now, it seems to be present below the privacy and terms line and the audit request line. What if we pull it above it? It feels off being below that line. What if we fix that thing as well while you are at it?” The change (direction A): sitemap → the lockup → the legal row. The lockup moves inside the content wrap, directly above the legal row, and its crop box (80% of its height) ends exactly where the legal hairline begins, so the line is the cut: the lockup sits on it and its lower fifth is buried behind it, with the same sliver of the smallest square showing as before. The hairline and its two + marks still close the frame the hero opened; the right + now lands on the lockup's lower-right corner, where it reads as a registration mark on the drawing. Every round-5 pick holds: one quiet tone (rgba 251,250,246,.13), ~70% of the content width (918px at 1440), set right, one-fifth buried. Spacing, tuned by eye: 112px of air from the strips to the lockup's visible top (the pause the founder already approved between the sitemap and the legal row), 0 from the lockup to the line (it sits on it), and the 88px legal band (the hero band's height) followed by a one-gutter foot (24px). Ending the page on the band itself put the controls 22px from the window's edge, which read as cut off rather than closed; 40px of foot made the band float. With 24px the controls hang from their line (22px under it) and the page settles under them (46px). The stage is now ≈804px: 128 top padding, label, strips, 112 air, 152px of visible lockup, the 88px band, 24px foot. The lockup is aria-hidden decoration (as in production): the bar's lockup already names the site, and the © row and controls follow the sitemap in reading order. The end beat waits for the reader (review pass): the section plays as its top arrives, which on a phone left the legal row about a screen below the fold, so the line drew and the lockup rose out of sight. The hairline, its + marks, © and the controls and the rise now hold at their first frame until half the legal row is on screen (data-end="wait", set by U.js / footer-behavior.ts, fail-open), then play in their order. When the reader is already there, nothing waits. Alternative B (the whole lockup above the line, uncropped, same tone/width/alignment, with air above the hairline) was rendered for comparison only (qa/r9-footer/alt) and not shipped. Production: src/components/layout/Footer.tsx + Footer.css (tablet ≤1023: strips two by two, lockup ~70% on the line, legal row wraps; phone ≤767: one column, lockup at the full content width on the line, legal row stacks). History (rounds 2–5, superseded where they describe the lockup under the legal row): The stage is 828px: 128 top padding, label, strips, 112px of air, the 88px legal row, 64px of air (raised from 40 so the buried lockup no longer crowds the legal buttons), then the 135.9px visible half of the lockup. The cut is a strict 50% of the lockup's height. Cuts from 54% to 57% leave a 2–6px sliver of the e's crossbar on the edge, and 58% reads as 'sitting low' rather than buried. The lockup is the base .km-logo mask (the founder's traced master) in currentColor, so there is no hand-drawn mark geometry anywhere. The section uses kit components (.ac-wrap, .ac-labelrow/.ac-label, .ac-strips/.ac-strip, .ac-idx, .ac-h3, .ac-cap, .ac-btn-o, .ac-reg) with placement-only overrides. Review pass: the rise used to run 2.6s --ease-out from 250ms. That made it 73% up by 1s, so it popped up before the legal row had appeared. It is now a 2s --ease-inout rise from 900ms and is the last thing to move. C quotas: 2 registration marks, 0 callouts, 0 dimensions, and mono only for the indices and the one © line. · Promoted unchanged from round-2 slot X. · Promoted unchanged from round-2 slot S. · Coherence pass (round 4): .km-footer-U__t--quiet gains margin-top 14px — the role line hugs '' and the colophon (same grey) stands apart. Stage 870 → 884px; the lockup crop is measured from the bottom edge and is unchanged.
addressed: The Kelwin lockup no longer sits below the Privacy | Terms and Audit request line: it is pulled above it and sits on that line, which buries its lower fifth, so the legal row is the last thing on the page.
One-fifth buried, the version you picked: a sliver of the smallest square shows above the line.
No longer pure white: the lockup is one quiet, low-contrast tone, so the links and contact details lead.
No longer full width: about 70% of the content width, right-aligned.
No mention of Plurel anywhere: the ‘Sister company of Plurel’ line is gone from the Contact column.
story: The coda and the index: after the decision comes the sitemap, and the only place the mark appears large.
